features.name: http_token
features.description: Uses HTTP instead of HTTPS (insecure)

features.name: url_length
features.description: Total length of URL

features.name: dot_count
features.description: Number of dots (.) in URL

features.name: hyphen_count
features.description: Number of hyphens (-) in URL

features.name: slash_count
features.description: Number of slashes (/) in URL

features.name: at_symbol_count
features.description: Number of @ symbols in URL

features.name: percent_count
features.description: Number of percent signs (%) in URL

features.name: special_char_count
features.description: Total special characters in URL

features.name: digit_ratio
features.description: Ratio of digits to total URL length

features.name: letter_ratio
features.description: Ratio of letters to total URL length

features.name: special_char_ratio
features.description: Ratio of special characters to total URL length

features.name: longest_digit_sequence
features.description: Length of longest consecutive digit sequence

features.name: longest_letter_sequence
features.description: Length of longest consecutive letter sequence

features.name: longest_special_sequence
features.description: Length of longest consecutive special character sequence

features.name: character_continuity_rate
features.description: Character type continuity rate (entropy proxy)

features.name: url_entropy
features.description: Shannon entropy of URL characters

features.name: low_entropy
features.description: Low entropy (<3.0) indicates simple/benign URL

features.name: high_entropy
features.description: High entropy (>4.0) indicates random/obfuscated URL

features.name: long_url_length
features.description: URL length >100 chars indicates obfuscation

features.name: high_digit_ratio
features.description: Digit ratio >30% indicates encoding/obfuscation

features.name: low_special_char_ratio
features.description: Special char ratio <5% indicates simple/benign URL

features.name: domain_length
features.description: Length of domain name (excluding protocol and path)

features.name: domain_token_count
features.description: Number of domain parts separated by dots

features.name: subdomain_count
features.description: Number of subdomains in URL

features.name: digit_ratio_domain
features.description: Ratio of digits to domain length

features.name: hyphen_count_domain
features.description: Number of hyphens (-) in domain

features.name: longest_domain_token
features.description: Length of longest domain part

features.name: avg_domain_token_length
features.description: Average length of domain parts

features.name: domain_entropy
features.description: Shannon entropy of domain (measures randomness)

features.name: ip_address_flag
features.description: Domain is an IP address instead of named domain

features.name: multiple_subdomain_flag
features.description: Has multiple subdomain levels (e.g., a.b.c.example.com)

features.name: brand_keyword_flag
features.description: Contains brand keywords in domain (e.g., paypal, google)

features.name: port_in_url_flag
features.description: Has an explicit port in URL (default or non-default)

features.name: https_in_domain
features.description: Contains 'https' in domain name (deception technique)

features.name: tld_suspicious_flag
features.description: Uses suspicious TLD (e.g., .tk, .ml, .ga, .cf, .gq)

features.name: shortening_service_flag
features.description: Is a URL shortener (e.g., bit.ly, tinyurl.com)

features.name: double_slash_redirecting
features.description: Has // in path (not after protocol) indicating redirect

features.name: punycode_domain_flag
features.description: Domain uses Punycode (xn--) - possible homograph attack

features.name: unicode_domain_flag
features.description: Domain has Unicode/non-ASCII characters (IDN spoofing)

features.name: homograph_suspicious_flag
features.description: Has similar-looking characters for deception (homograph attack)

features.name: excessive_subdomain_depth
features.description: Excessive subdomain depth (>4 levels indicates spam)

features.name: random_string_domain_flag
features.description: Domain appears random/meaningless (high entropy, indicates DGA)

features.name: free_hosting_domain_flag
features.description: Uses free hosting service (000webhost, freenom, etc.)

features.name: dga_domain_flag
features.description: Domain likely from Domain Generation Algorithm (C&C)

features.name: non_standard_port_flag
features.description: Uses non-standard port (4444, 1337, 8080, 8888 - C&C)

features.name: high_domain_entropy
features.description: Domain entropy >3.8 indicates random/obfuscated domain

features.name: path_length
features.description: Length of path in URL (after domain)

features.name: path_token_count
features.description: Number of path segments separated by /

features.name: digit_ratio_path
features.description: Ratio of digits to path length

features.name: dot_count_path
features.description: Number of dots (.) in path

features.name: longest_path_token
features.description: Length of longest path segment

features.name: avg_path_token_length
features.description: Average length of path segments

features.name: path_entropy
features.description: Shannon entropy of path (measures randomness)

features.name: filename_length
features.description: Length of filename in path (last segment)

features.name: suspicious_extension_flag
features.description: Has suspicious file extension (e.g., .exe, .bat, .scr, .vbs)

features.name: executable_extension_flag
features.description: Has executable file extension

features.name: suspicious_js_extension_flag
features.description: Has .js file or javascript: protocol (Drive-by Download)

features.name: query_length
features.description: Length of query string (after ?)

features.name: parameter_count
features.description: Number of parameters in query string

features.name: digit_ratio_query
features.description: Ratio of digits to query string length

features.name: equal_count_query
features.description: Number of equals signs (=) in query string

features.name: ampersand_count_query
features.description: Number of ampersands (&) in query string

features.name: avg_parameter_length
features.description: Average length of parameters in query string

features.name: max_parameter_length
features.description: Maximum length of parameter in query string

features.name: query_entropy
features.description: Shannon entropy of query string

features.name: encoded_url_flag
features.description: Has URL encoding in query (e.g., %20, %3A)

features.name: redirect_parameter_flag
features.description: Has redirect parameter (url=, redirect=, next=, return=, goto=)

features.name: script_in_url_flag
features.description: Contains 'script' in URL or parameter (Drive-by Download)

features.name: auto_download_param_flag
features.description: Has auto-download parameter (download=, file=, get=)

features.name: base64_in_url_flag
features.description: Has Base64 encoding in URL (C&C communication)

features.name: mixed_token_flag
features.description: Has mixed letters and digits in same token

features.name: hex_encoding_flag
features.description: Has hexadecimal encoding (e.g., %20, %3A, %2F)

features.name: obfuscation_pattern_flag
features.description: Has obfuscation patterns (e.g., abnormally long strings)
